standard_prerequisites.name: The characterization of local quasi-finiteness through locally finite type and discrete field fibres
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 5010-5018)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives discreteness of the space from the hypothesis.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of a locally finite type stack over a field through a presentation by a group action
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 5019-5030)
standard_prerequisites.use: Exhibits the stack as a quotient of points by finite groups.

core_obligations: Discreteness: local quasi-finiteness is equivalent to local finite type together with discreteness of the field fibres, so the space of the stack is discrete (proof lines 5009-5018)

Decomposition: presenting the stack over the field by a smooth cover, the discreteness of the space makes the cover a disjoint union of points, and each point contributes a quotient of a point by the automorphism group of the corresponding object, which is finite because the fibre over a point of a discrete space is finite (proof lines 5019-5033)
proof_roadmap: 由局部拟有限的刻画：局部有限型 + 域上纤维离散 ⇒ |X| 离散。
取光滑展示 U → X，U 在域上局部有限型 ⇒ U 是若干点的并；每点上的自同构群有限。
故 X 是「点 / 有限群」的并，即每个点上只有有限自同构群。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an algebraic stack locally quasi-finite over a field is a disjoint union of points each with finite automorphism group (author lemma at source lines 5001-5007, label lemma-locally-quasi-finite-over-field). The proof (source lines 5009-5034) applies the discreteness characterization of local quasi-finiteness, presents the stack by a smooth cover and reads off the finite automorphism groups from the points of that cover (proof lines 5009-5033). The reduction to the presentation and the finiteness of the automorphism groups are the substance. H3.
